name: skill-suites
description: Agent Skills suites: groups of skills that work together, one plugin per suite.

plugins.name: skill-suites-dr
plugins.description: Runs deep research with working memory on disk, either exploring a topic for leads or building a challenged, claim-checked report, then audits or refreshes past runs.

plugins.name: skill-suites-ops
plugins.description: Turns a pile of installed skills into a plan that picks which to run and in what order, runs them with backups and check-ins, and remembers which sequences worked.
